eMeshState.description:
State of the finite element mesh of the analysis model. A tri-state and not a boolean: Advance Design distinguishes "no mesh" from "a mesh that could not cover the whole model", and a calculation is allowed to run on the latter.

Possible values:

  • 0 - mesh_no: No mesh. Either the analysis model was never meshed, or the mesh was dropped (ReinitializeAnalysisModel, a model conversion).
  • 1 - mesh_available: A complete mesh: every element that had to be meshed was, so the solver has a full structure to work on. This is the only state in which finite element results are meaningful everywhere.
  • 2 - mesh_incomplete: A mesh exists but is INCOMPLETE - the mesher could not mesh part of the model. Advance Design still lets the calculation run on it, so results may exist while whole parts of the structure have no finite elements at all. Treat it as a warning, not as a success: check the mesh diagnostics of the last LaunchAnalysis before trusting any result.

eModelSettingsCategory.description:
One group of general model settings - what `GetModelSettings` and `ResetModelSettings` name, and what the runtime type of a `ModelSettingsBase` object belongs to. A category is a group of settings that the desktop application edits in one dialog and that the API therefore reads, writes and resets as one object. It is NOT the same thing as the `$type` of the settings object: the category says WHICH settings, the `$type` says which SHAPE they have - one category can have several shapes, as the combination generation settings have one per combination standard.

Possible values:

  • 0 - None: Not a settings group. It is the value an omitted parameter takes, so a request carrying it is refused rather than silently answered with a default group.
  • 1 - CombinationsGeneration: The settings the automatic ("simplified") combination generation runs with - the general options the Combinations options dialog of the desktop application edits.
  • 2 - SteelEc3Calculation: The general options of the Expert steel (Eurocode 3) design calculation - what the Calculation Settings dialog of the desktop application edits, tab by tab: which verifications are performed, the partial safety factors, the imperfection and buckling options, the optimisation criteria, the profile sort order, the angle-verification bolt factors and the calculation sequence.
  • 3 - SteelAiscCalculation: The general options of the Expert steel design calculation of a model designed to a NORTH-AMERICAN code - AISC 360, AISC 360-16 and the four CAN/CSA S16 editions. The same Calculation Settings dialog as

ePermanentLoadSituation.description:
How the permanent actions enter the combinations - mirrors enumPermanentLoadingSituation.

Possible values:

  • 0 - Unfavorable: Unfavorable only. The default.
  • 1 - Favorable: Favorable only.
  • 2 - FavorableAndUnfavorable: Both, generating one combination of each.
  • 3 - UserDefined: The gamma values on the settings are used as they are sent instead of being taken from the standard's table. This is the ONLY situation in which they are writable.

ePermanentLoadSituation2ndGen.description:
How a permanent action enters the 2nd generation combinations - mirrors enumPermanentLoadingSituation2Gen. Longer than its 1st generation counterpart AD.API.ePermanentLoadSituation, because EN 1990:2023 adds the stabilizing cases of verification case VC2.

Possible values:

  • 0 - Unfavorable: Unfavorable only. The default.
  • 1 - Favorable: Favorable only.
  • 2 - FavorableAndUnfavorable: Both favorable and unfavorable.
  • 3 - FavorableUnfavorableStabilizingVC2: Favorable, unfavorable, and stabilizing for VC2.
  • 4 - FavorableStabilizingVC2: Favorable and stabilizing for VC2.
  • 5 - UserDefined: The gamma values on the row are used as they are sent.

eSlsCombinationSituation.description:
Which serviceability situation the generated SLS combinations are labelled with. Independent of the three `SlsCharacteristic` / `SlsFrequent` / `SlsQuasiPermanent` switches, which decide WHICH ones are generated.

Possible values:

  • 0 - Characteristic:
  • 1 - Frequent:
  • 2 - QuasiPermanent:

eSteelBucklingLengthMethod.description:
How the automatic buckling lengths are computed. Shared with the native `enumBucklingCalculMethod`; the model field is `ChoixMethode`. The steel design code decides which of these the dialog leaves enabled, and a request naming one the active code does not offer is refused. Under the Eurocode that is `eMethodBucklingKa_Kb` and `eMethodBucklingN1_N2` only.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eMethodBucklingRoA_RoB: The rho_A / rho_B method. CM66 only.
  • 1 - eMethodBucklingKa_Kb: The Ka / Kb method (CM66), also offered under the Eurocode.
  • 2 - eMethodBucklingN1_N2: The eta1 / eta2 method (EC3 ENV) - the enumerator is spelled N1_N2 after the Greek letters. The default of a new Eurocode model.
  • 3 - eMethodBucklingGa_Gb: The GA - GB method. AISC and CAN/CSA only.
  • 4 - eMethodBucklingGu_Gl: The Gu - Gl variant.
  • -1 - eMethodBucklingNone: No method selected.

eSteelBucklingLengthOption.description:
Where the buckling length of a member comes from when imperfections are accounted for. Shared with the native `enumSteelImperfectionsBucklingOption`; the model fields are `ColumnsBucklingOption` and `BeamsBucklingOption`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - elementLength: Buckling length = the length of the element.
  • 1 - imposed: Buckling length = what the element's own properties impose. The default of a new model, since Defect #20404.
  • 2 - neglected: Buckling is neglected.

eSteelCalculationType.description:
Which internal forces the steel verification combines. Shared with the native `enumTypeDeCalcul`; the model field is `TypeDeCalcul`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eTypeDeCalculTractionCompression: Tension - compression only.
  • 1 - eTypeDeCalculComposedBending: Combined bending: axial force with bending about one axis.
  • 2 - eTypeDeCalculBiaxialBending: Oblique (biaxial) bending. The default of a new model.

eSteelImperfectionGeneration.description:
Which combinations the geometric imperfections are generated for. Shared with the native `eImperfectionGeneration`; the model field is `ImperfectionGeneration`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eImperfectionGenerationForGoverningComb: For the governing combinations only. The default of a new Eurocode model.
  • 1 - eImperfectionGenerationForAllComb: For all combinations.
  • -1 - eImperfectionGenerationUndefined: Not decided - what a model whose steel design code is not of the Eurocode family carries. READ ONLY in practice, for the same reason

eSteelInteractionFactorMethod.description:
Which expression the interaction factors k_ij come from. Shared with the native `enumInteractionFactor_kij_Method`; the model field is `InteractionFactor_kij_method`. SECOND GENERATION ONLY: stored whatever the steel code is, but read only by the EN 1993-1-1:2023 engine, and the dialog hides the control for every other code.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eInteractionFactor_kij_Method_EN1993: EN 1993-1-1:2023, 8.3.3. The default of a new model.
  • 1 - eInteractionFactor_kij_Method_CEN_TS_1993: CEN/TS 1993-1-101.

eSteelOptimizationMode.description:
How the optimisation groups the elements it may change the section of. Shared with the native `enumOptimizationType`; the model field is `ModeOptimisation`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eOptimizationParElements: Each element on its own. The default of a new model.
  • 1 - eOptimizationParSections: All the elements sharing a cross-section change together.
  • 2 - eOptimizationParRole: All the elements sharing a design template (som.Role) change together.
  • 3 - eOptimizationParName: All the elements sharing a name change together.
  • 4 - eOptimizationParSystems: All the elements of a structural system change together.
  • -1 - eOptimizationNonExistant: No optimisation mode. A sentinel of the native enumeration: nothing ever stores it in the model, and AD.API refuses it in a request - the dialog's radio group cannot be cleared. It is listed only because this body is shared with the native declaration.

eSteelOptimizationSearchRange.description:
How far the optimisation is allowed to search. Shared with the native `enumProfileOptimizationSearchRange`; the model field is `MaxIterationsType`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eProfileOptimizationSearchRangeAuto: Automatically determined. The default of a new model; the maximum iteration count is then ignored and the dialog disables its edit field.
  • 1 - eProfileOptimizationSearchRangeAutoWithMaxLimit: Automatically determined, but never more iterations than the stored maximum allows.

eSteelPlateBucklingMethod.description:
How a slender plate (web) of the cross-section is verified. Shared with the native `eWebBucklingCalculationMethod`; the model field is `WebBucklingMethod`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eMethodWebBucklingEffectiveCrossSections: Effective width method - EN 1993-1-5 sections 4, 5, 6 and 7.
  • 1 - eMethodWebBucklingReducedStresses: Reduced stress method - EN 1993-1-5 section 10. The Czech and Slovak national annexes do not offer it, and the dialog warns when it is picked under them.
  • -1 - eMethodWebBucklingUndefined: Not decided - "no option selected". What a model carries when its steel design code offers no plate buckling at all; a Eurocode model is created with

eSteelProfileOrderingCriterion.description:
The order in which candidate profiles are tried. Shared with the native `enumProfileOptimizationOrderingCriterion`; the model field is `ProfileOptimizationOrderingCriterion`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eProfileOptimizationOrderedByHeight: By section height.
  • 1 - eProfileOptimizationOrderedByWidth: By section width.
  • 2 - eProfileOptimizationOrderedByIyInertia: By the second moment of area about the strong axis.
  • 3 - eProfileOptimizationOrderedByIzInertia: By the second moment of area about the weak axis.
  • 4 - eProfileOptimizationOrderedByWeight: By weight per unit length. The default of a new model.

eSteelProfileSortCriterion.description:
Which work ratio decides that a profile is acceptable. Shared with the native `enumTriCriteria`; the model field is `ModeTri`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eTriCriteriaDeflections: The deflection work ratio alone.
  • 1 - eTriCriteriaWorkRatio: The strength / stability work ratio alone.
  • 2 - eTriCriteriaEnveloppe: The envelope of both. The default of a new Eurocode model.

eSteelSafetyFactorsOption.description:
Whether the partial safety factors are taken from the design code or imposed by the user. Shared with the native `enumSafetyFactorsOption`; the model field is `SteelSafetyFactorsOption`.

Possible values:

  • 0 - eSafetyFactorsAuto: The design code and its national annex decide. The default. The gamma values then become READ ONLY: a value sent for one of them is dropped and reported as a warning.
  • 1 - eSafetyFactorsImposed: The gamma values of the request are stored as sent.

eTimberCombinationType.description:
Limit state under which the timber design engine checks a combination.

eTimberDeflectionCriterion.description:
Deflection criterion checked by the timber design engine.

eTimberLoadDuration.description:

ASCE 7 factor f1 on the live load in the accidental (fire) combinations - mirrors enumUSCoeffF1LiveLoads.

  • 1 - RoofOthers: Other roof configurations: f2 = 0.2.
